title: 第一卷 第3章 退婚第一卷 第4章 秦家
lines: 秦玄冷酷的说着。
既然这女人想要和他有个了断，那就断个干净！
“哼，算你识相！”
柳依依的侍女得意的冷哼一声，还以为秦玄被赵龙腾的身份给吓住了。
“不过，既然要退婚，那这些年来，我给你的宝物、兵器还有灵石什么的，你是不是该还回来了？”
“这些东西是我以未婚夫的身份赠送与你，现在既然要解除婚约，那你是不是该退回来？”
随着秦玄话音落下，柳依依难以置信地看向秦玄。
秦玄竟然想要将这些年来送给她的东西都给要回去。
低头看了眼自己手上的冰魄剑，还有秦玄给的乾坤戒以及避尘珠不由得一阵舍不得。
还不等她开口，秦玄便继续开口。
“不只是这些，三年前，你我订婚之时，我们秦家给你们柳家整整十万灵石作为彩礼，你们柳家不会都给花完了吧？”
“三日之后，我会登门造访，希望你们柳家准备好东西！”
“姓秦的，你给我站住！”
柳依依的肺都要气炸了。
秦玄怎么能要回他送过来的礼物和彩礼！
“秦玄，你还是不是个男人！送出来的东西，怎么能要回去？”
柳依依愤怒的朝着秦玄大吼大叫。
听着柳依依愤怒喊声，秦玄冷酷的转过头来，冷冷盯着这对主仆。
被秦玄那凶戾的目光一瞪，柳依依和她身边的侍女顿时闭嘴不敢开口。
不过很快柳依依就反应了过来。
一个废人而已！
有什么资格和自己说话。
想到这里，她的胆气又壮了起来。
“你还要不要脸？当年你和我盟山誓海的时候，可是亲手将这些东西送给了我，现在不过是要退婚，你竟然想要回去！”
“送出去的东西，怎么能要回去？”
“你这可是自愿赠予我的，既然是自愿，凭什么要收回去！”
“男人，果然都不可靠！”
柳依依说着，眼中竟然泛起了一丝泪光。
看着这一幕，围观的众人顿时吵嚷了起来。
“我的天哪，她竟然还委屈上了，真是人不要脸，天下无敌啊！”
“哈哈，没错，就算是城南勾栏里的头牌，拿了银子也是要好好伺候人的！”
“不办事还想拿钱，这算盘珠子响的，只怕玄龙城的人都能听到了.....”
众人各种嘲讽，可此时的柳依依死死抱着秦玄当年给她的兵器。
一个月后就是苍青宗在火风城的初选了。
作为整个玄龙道第一大宗门，要是能加入苍青宗，那柳家就可以彻底成为火风城一流家族。
因此，无论如何，她都不愿意将手中的东西交给秦玄。
“小姐，你不用怕！”
就在这时，柳依依身旁的侍女跳了出来。
“小姐，你当年与他已经定下过婚约，你也算是等了他三年。”
“这么算下来，要是退婚，他可还得分一半家产给咱们柳家！”
想到这里，这个侍女立即双手叉腰走上前来。
“姓秦的，看在当年婚约的份上，只要你主动将秦家家产交给我们柳家一半，我们柳家可以勉强原谅你的无礼......”
这侍女话音未落，秦玄便狠狠地一巴掌抽在她的脸上。
content_en:
Qin Xuan said coldly.
Since this woman wants to end things with him, let’s do it completely!
"Hmph, you know what's going on!"
Liu Yiyi's maid snorted proudly, thinking that Qin Xuan was frightened by Zhao Longteng's identity.
"However, since we want to break off the engagement, shouldn't you return the treasures, weapons, spiritual stones and other things I have given you over the years?"
"I gave these things to you as my fiancé. Now that the engagement is about to be terminated, should you return them?"
As Qin Xuan finished speaking, Liu Yiyi looked at Qin Xuan in disbelief.
Qin Xuan actually wanted to take back all the things he had given her over the years.
He lowered his head and looked at the Ice Soul Sword in his hand, as well as the Qiankun Ring and Bichen Pearl given by Qin Xuan, and couldn't help but feel reluctant to part with them.
Before she could speak, Qin Xuan continued to speak.
"It's not just these. Three years ago, when you and I got engaged, our Qin family gave your Liu family a hundred thousand spiritual stones as a gift. Didn't your Liu family spend all of it?"
"I will visit you in three days. I hope your Liu family has prepared something!"
"Qin, stop right here!"
Liu Yiyi's lungs were about to explode.
How could Qin Xuan get back the gifts and betrothal gifts he sent!
"Qin Xuan, you are still not a man! How can you take back what you gave away?"
Liu Yiyi yelled at Qin Xuan angrily.
Listening to Liu Yiyi's angry shouts, Qin Xuan turned his head coldly and stared at the master and servant coldly.
After being stared at by Qin Xuan's fierce gaze, Liu Yiyi and the maid beside her immediately shut up and did not dare to speak.
But Liu Yiyi soon reacted.
Just a useless person!
What qualifications do you have to speak to yourself?
Thinking of this, her courage became stronger again.
"Are you still shameless? When you and I were sworn to each other, you personally gave these things to me. Now you just want to break off the engagement, and you actually want to go back!"
"How can you take back what you gave away?"
"You gave this to me voluntarily. Since it was voluntary, why should you take it back!"
"Men are indeed unreliable!"
Liu Yiyi said, with a trace of tears in her eyes.
Seeing this scene, everyone onlookers suddenly started shouting.
"Oh my god, she is still wronged. She is so shameless and invincible in the world!"
"Haha, that's right. Even if you are the top one in Gou Lan in the south of the city, you still have to serve people well after receiving the money!"
"I want to get money without doing anything. The abacus is so loud that everyone in Xuanlong City can hear it..."
Everyone was ridiculing, but at this moment Liu Yiyi tightly held the weapon Qin Xuan gave her.
In one month's time, the Cang Qing Sect's primary election in Fire Wind City will begin.
As the largest sect in the entire Xuanlong Dao, if they can join the Cang Qing Sect, the Liu family can completely become a first-class family in Fire Wind City.
Therefore, she was unwilling to hand over the things in her hands to Qin Xuan no matter what.
"Miss, you don't have to be afraid!"
At this moment, the maid beside Liu Yiyi jumped out.
"Miss, you had already made an engagement with him back then, so you have been waiting for him for three years."
"After all, if the engagement is broken off, he will still give half of his family property to our Liu family!"
Thinking of this, the maid immediately stepped forward with her hands on her hips.
"Qin, for the sake of the engagement, as long as you take the initiative to hand over half of the Qin family's property to our Liu family, our Liu family can reluctantly forgive your rudeness..."
"Crack!"
Before the maid finished speaking, Qin Xuan slapped her hard on the face.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 3 Breaking off the Engagement Volume 1 Chapter 4 The Qin Family
